title: ios app sucks
body: habitica is okay but the ios app is horrible. cron rarely happens on first try, the app is very slow, it freezes every time i try to check more than one task as done.. the app is kind of useless since it’s too unreliable to use as a habit tracker or to do list which is habitica’s only use without the social aspects (killing the guilds was a mistake!).
author: kauko12

title: The app is going downhill
body: This service has staff that don’t care about its users. The mistreatment of ex-moderators and contributors and censorship of their issues are leading into a decline in the quality of the app too - they can’t keep up with actually having to do all the work themselves since taking moderator duties in-house. Check r/Habitica on Reddit for context.

author: Lintuli

title: Amazing!
body:
Such a wonderful app and game. Have been using this for a few weeks now and it’s made a major difference. I feel more productive and inclined to better my bad habits and to partake in good ones. I love games, and the game aspect of this really taps into my eagerness to play and improve my character, and thereby be mor productive and better about my habits.

I’ve tried all kinds of habit-changer apps and always gave up after a day or two. Habitica is fun, pretty, and has a great community that’s very helpful.

100% worth the download and a go if, like me, you’ve been trying to improve your habits for ages but not really gotten much progress! So happy that I discovered Habitica—best thing that’s happened to me in 2019!
author: Dragonsphinx
